changelog:
Home Canning & Food Preservation v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides step-by-step home canning protocol, with agent-guided recipe validation using current USDA/NCHFP safety guidelines.
- Automatically calculates altitude-adjusted processing times/pressures and logs every batch and inventory.
- Generates interactive checklists, reminders, and rotation prompts to ensure safe storage and use.
- Includes templates for inventory tracking, rotation reminder emails, and shopping offsets.
- Clearly defines division of labor: agent handles all safety computation and scheduling; human performs all physical canning tasks.
summary: Use when you have surplus garden produce, foraged items, bulk buys, or need reliable shelf-stable food for 12–36 months in unstable supply chains, blackouts,...
